trigger.raw_text: The user selects one or more files or archives in the file manager interface.

claims.content: The user selects one or more files or archives in the file manager interface.

The system displays an information list for the selected items, showing details such as number of files, older and newer object's date/time, total space occupation, larger and smaller object's sizes, type, size (B), packed size, date/time, attributes, CRC, and full name.
The user can optionally view the content of a file represented as hexadecimal values by selecting the 'Hexadecimal preview' option from the available utilities.
The user selects the 'Hexadecimal preview' option from the available utilities to view the content of a file represented as hexadecimal values.
The user has viewed detailed information about the selected files or archives.
The system has displayed metadata including size, type, date/time, attributes, CRC, and full name for each selected item.
If requested, the system has rendered a hexadecimal preview of the file content.
